criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: The official Family Express FAQ lists its Purdue location at 1812 Northwestern Avenue. OSM way 374563309 independently carries the same name/address and retail/convenience tags. This fresh-open evaluator projected its raw nine-vertex ring and compared it to the floor slab ring in both directions.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The model keeps the campus-coordinate footprint in the expected master location. The evaluator compares every projected source edge against the model floor-ring edges; bounds and plan orientation agree within the local project transform. This confirms agreement with the volunteered outline, not a surveyed wall location.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The address-associated MapQuest exterior result depicts a one-story brick retail store with a low charcoal hip roof. The model has one occupied level and a charcoal hipped roof. Exact eave/ridge heights and roof pitch are estimated; neither OSM nor the source photograph supplies measured elevations.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The model has red-brown brick, a broad glazed storefront/double entry, pale fascia, blue Family Express signs, and a separate white canopy with black supports and six dispenser assemblies, matching the location-associated exterior reference at a broad architectural level. The simplified pumps, signage, absent site paving/vehicles, and low visual detail reduce correspondence.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh Blender open confirms the expected scene/collection, 503 objects (500 meshes and 3 fonts), 19 materials, and no linked libraries or unpacked images. OSM raw snapshot, source metadata, address evidence, builder script, and exterior/top/interior previews are present. The interior is schematic, roof height and canopy placement are estimated, and the matched image itself is cited by URL rather than preserved locally.

evidence: Official Family Express FAQ: https://familyexpress.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018927412-Where-are-the-Pet-Washes-located-what-are-the-hours-offered (Purdue store address).
OSM source snapshot: audit/family_express/sources/osm_way_374563309_2026-10-26.json; building way 374563309, last edited 2024-01-17.

Address-associated MapQuest exterior listing/image: https://www.mapquest.com/us/indiana/family-express-378696207 and https://a.mktgcdn.com/p/Q6dWIcLGo--LQCuVeEj1P7dUFpVXkHcROmqnBpKyuqE/2048x1362.jpg (retrieved in image search; date not exposed).
Independent fresh-open visual inspection: audit/family_express/exterior_preview.png, top_preview.png, and interior_cutaway_preview.png.
findings: Roof pitch, eave/ridge height, canopy geolocation/dimensions, and pump placement remain estimates.
The interior shows representative store fixtures but has no source floor plan.
The preview uses a uniform gray background; the saved exterior view does not include site paving, approach roads, vehicles, or surrounding campus context.
The OSM outline is community mapped, not a surveyed wall footprint.
